description: Pre-sign check, before an agent signs anything on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663): send the transaction (to, data, value, and from), a message to sign (message: {kind: personal_sign | eth_sign, data, origin?}), an EIP-712 signature request (typedData), an ERC-4337 user operation (userOp, with entryPoint), a type-4 authorizationList (alone or with the transaction), the wallet request as the agent would send it (rpc: {method, params} for personal_sign, eth_sign, eth_signTypedData_v4 or eth_sendTransaction), or an x402 payment (x402: the PaymentRequired from the 402, or one accepts entry; agentId optional), and Toll answers ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK with the reasons, as an ERC-8265 RiskAssessment. It reads approvals (unlimited, to a plain wallet, to a contract we do not know, to a wallet the coin's own check names), transfers (to a burn address, the token itself, a router, a flagged wallet, an unknown contract), swaps (the router, who it pays out to, and the coin bought, through Toll's coin check: BLOCK only for findings whose coins rugged at 40% or more in our calibration; a single-pool Uniswap v4 swap off the coin's main pool is quoted on the main pool, WARN when that pays more than 3% more), Uniswap v4 position manager calls (modifyLiquidities, its multicall, initializePool, permit: liquidity paid out or a position minted to anyone but from is a warning), Hookr's calls as its MCP builds them (HookrRouter swap, swapFor, swapGated; HookrLauncher launches, a launch's own withdrawal and fee collection, a pool core's claim, a revenue token's claim, the Agent gate link and reviewer set, the order book fill: each named as Hookr's contract, never trusted; an unknown hook, rules contract or add-on in a launch, or a payout to anyone but from, is a warning), and x402 payments (ERC-8478 payee verification: payTo against the seller's ERC-8004 agent wallet or a payee delegation it signed, read live from the Robinhood Chain or Base identity registry, with the outcome in x-toll; the seller's last delivery spot-check, the asset and amount; an upto payment's signed maximum, which the seller may charge in full; an auth-capture payment's escrow, token collector and hold). The coin bought's name and symbol, and every text field of EIP-712 typed data (domain name and version, message strings), are scanned for instructions aimed at AI agents. Calldata it cannot read is never ALLOW: WARN, high when it sends ETH, and BLOCK at 0.05 ETH or more, or any ETH to an address with no code. It reads personal_sign and eth_sign messages (Sign-In with Ethereum included: domain against origin, expiry; eth_sign of a hash is BLOCK), any EIP-712 typed data (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009, Seaport, UniswapX, and any other named field by field), ERC-4337 user operations (the account's calls, the EntryPoint, the paymaster), and multicall, Safe and smart-account batches leaf by leaf, each warning with its path. For a signature it says what it lets someone take: the amount signed, the owner's balance and what the spender could take now, simulated at the current block (in USD where Toll has a price). An EIP-7702 delegation (a type-4 authorizationList or a signAuthorization alone) to a delegate Toll has verified by code hash is WARN; any other is BLOCK, each delegate and chain named. A coin still being read is WARN with the seconds to wait. It simulates the transaction at the current block (balance changes, approvals, revert) and can compare it with an optional intent ({action: swap|transfer|approve|pay, sellToken, sellAmount in base units, buyToken, minBuy, to, spender, maxAmount, tolerancePct}). A failed simulation is reported as not read, never ALLOW; a transaction without from cannot be simulated and is WARN. Add ticket: true to get a signed single-use ALLOW ticket (60 s, never for a BLOCK) that a contract can require before it runs this exact call. Robinhood Chain only. Facts, not advice.

agentId.description: The x402 seller's ERC-8004 agent id, when known

authorizationList.description: A type-4 (EIP-7702) transaction's authorizationList, or a signAuthorization alone (no to, no data): [{chainId, address, nonce, yParity, r, s}]. A delegate Toll has verified by code hash is WARN; any other is BLOCK

authorization_list.description: The same list under its snake_case name

chainId.description: The chain id: 4663 (Robinhood Chain), the only one read; leave it out for 4663

data.description: The calldata, hex (0x for a plain send)

entryPoint.description: The userOp's EntryPoint address (0x + 40 hex); an EntryPoint Toll does not know is a warning

from.description: The signer's address (0x + 40 hex): a swap paying out to anyone else is flagged

intent.description: Optional: what the agent means to do, compared with what the transaction does in the simulation. {action: "swap" | "transfer" | "approve" | "pay", sellToken?, sellAmount? (base units, decimal string), buyToken?, minBuy? (base units), to? (who should receive), spender? (who may spend), maxAmount? (approval cap, base units), tolerancePct? (extra outflow allowed on sellAmount, default 1)}. A token is an address or ETH, WETH or USDG. A mismatch is a warning; the findings are in x-toll.intent

message.description: A message to sign: {kind: "personal_sign" | "eth_sign", data (0x hex or text), origin? (the site asking), from?}. Sign-In with Ethereum is read (domain against origin, expiry); eth_sign of a hash is BLOCK

origin.description: The site or app asking for the signature (https://...), checked against a Sign-In with Ethereum domain

registry.description: The identity registry agentId is in, CAIP-10 (default eip155:4663:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432, Robinhood Chain; Base: eip155:8453:0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432)

rpc.description: The wallet request as the agent would send it: {method, params}. personal_sign [data, address], eth_sign [address, data], eth_signTypedData_v4 [address, typed data JSON], eth_sendTransaction [tx]

strict.description: Strict payee policy: an x402 payment whose payTo is not verified as the seller's (ERC-8478 verified-wallet or verified-delegation) is BLOCK instead of a warning; not read is BLOCK too

ticket.description: Optional: ask for a single-use ALLOW ticket a contract can require: true, or {consumer? (the contract that checks it), scope? "call" | "v4swap", swap? {poolId, zeroForOne, amountSpecified, sqrtPriceLimitX96}}. Returned in x-toll.ticket {ticket, signature, signer}, or {why} when none

to.description: The transaction's to: the contract or wallet it is sent to (0x + 40 hex)

typedData.description: An EIP-712 signature request: {domain, types, primaryType, message}. Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009, Seaport, UniswapX, or any other (named field by field)

userOp.description: An ERC-4337 user operation (v0.6, v0.7 packed or unpacked, v0.8): sender, nonce, callData, gas fields, paymaster, signature. Its calls are opened and each checked

value.description: Wei sent with it, decimal or 0x hex (default 0)

x402.description: An x402 payment: the PaymentRequired the 402 sent (with accepts), or one accepts entry; optional payment (the signed payload) and resource (the URL)

name: check_tx
title: Check before signing
